## Severity-ladder grid, 300k env steps (HEADLINE)

One row per trained agent per rung. `success` columns use every agent; the drop columns use agents with house-A success ≥ 0.5 (count shown): drop = house-A success minus success at the rung, in percentage points, and the relative drop divides it by house-A success. L2noT is deliberately NOT pooled here: for 7 cells it was measured on a retrained agent (`rerun_300k`), so an L2noT row would average different agents than the rows beside it.
